title: Reborn Coffee, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Reborn Coffee, Inc. (ticker: REBN, Nasdaq Capital Market) filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026 disclosing an Amended and Restated Forbearance Agreement with Arena Investors, amending the repayment terms for 10% Original Issue Discount Secured Convertible Debentures. The company must pay $400,000 by April 30, 2026, $400,000 monthly starting May 30, 2026, and all remaining amounts by September 30, 2026.
key_points: Reborn Coffee entered into an A&R Forbearance Agreement on April 15, 2026 with Arena Investors, amending prior agreements from February 2025, March 2025, and July 2025
Payment schedule: $425,000 by April 30, 2026 ($400,000 to Arena Investors + $25,000 for legal expenses)
Monthly payments of $400,000 to Arena Investors starting May 30, 2026
Full repayment of remaining debt required by September 30, 2026
Company must pay Arena Investors 70% of any proceeds from securities sales
Company must file a registration statement within 20 business days of filing its 10-K covering shares underlying warrants
